sourceNote: Open items need a decision; each has an owner and a date. Decided items stay for the record. Flip status to 'decided' and keep the row.

decisions.title: Confirm Trinity delivery commitments and training readiness
decisions.detail: Trinity confirmed on October 21 that the proposed property permissions and Approval Groups address its regional approval needs. The remaining open item is delivery commitments and client validation, not whether to support Trinity. November 18 is tentative training dependent on the required functionality; no replacement launch date is confirmed. Original AOP target: October 15.
decisions.source: Trinity / Entrata Homebody RXP Check-in, October 21, 2026; https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xMi9u0enNn0smEdm-tahWPvfI6hrME1EslvVbiUWTzc/edit

decisions.title: Continued Rewards sales in 2027 confirmed
decisions.detail: Continued Rewards sales in 2027 confirmed. New pricing is available in Salesforce, the Landmark deal was approved with contracting expected in October per Alex, and additional student operators are in the pipeline. The original decision target was October 15.
decisions.source: Britton Pederson and Catherine Wong Slack exchange, October 19, 2026

decisions.title: New lock date for HBG renewal requirements
decisions.detail: The Oct 13 critical-path date passed with no update recorded. Set the new date and record what the Robert Jones meeting locked.

decisions.title: Finance approval of $142k in IVS client credits
decisions.detail: Clients have been paying for IVS they were not receiving. Credits must be approved before client outreach begins. Chris takes the request to Finance and records the outcome here.

decisions.title: One war room for Homebody and HBG
decisions.detail: HBG (Homebody Guaranty) falls under Homebody. This surface covers both. There is no separate HBG war room.

decisions.title: Why this war room exists
decisions.detail: To drive Homebody revenue growth (target: +10% in Q1 2027, final number to be confirmed). Elevated client concerns going into and coming out of Summit were the trigger and remain the signal of friction against that goal, not the goal itself. The huddle is twice weekly. Reframed 2026-10-15.

decisions.title: HBG transfers are off the renewals critical path
decisions.detail: Jae: transfers should be improved, and they should not sit on the renewals critical path. Renewals stay on the critical path. Transfers get a separate epic.

decisions.title: HBG renewal is not DA auto-renewal
decisions.detail: A renewal lease interval must exist. Month-to-month, including rolling to month-to-month because move-out has not been performed, does not qualify. Do not copy how Deposit Alternative auto-renewal works today.
